summary: tailwindcss-3d-animate ships obfuscated blockchain-C2 loader appended to index.js
details: Package name mimics the legitimate tailwindcss-3d (sambauers/tailwindcss-3d referenced in package.json). index.js exports the legitimate plugin code and then appends a base64 blob that decodes to an obfuscator.io-style string-array loader (campaign marker 'A10-npm_new1'). The loader smuggles global.r=require and global.m=module, imports http/https/zlib and child_process.spawn, and resolves an attacker-controlled next stage by querying Ethereum RPC and Blockscout endpoints (h.drpc.org, mainnet-ethereum.publicnode.com, eth-mainnet.blastapi.io, eth.blockscout.com) for transaction data associated with hardcoded EVM address 0xa322E5f3. Any require() of this package executes the loader, fetches the next stage from the address returned by the on-chain lookup, and spawns it — arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine. Destinations, obfuscation shape, and campaign string match the A10-npm dropper family.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
